mapper.sql: classes.id AS id, classes.parent_id AS parentId, classes_parent.name AS parentName, classes.name AS `name`, classes.description AS description, classes.ordering AS `ordering`, DATE_FORMAT(classes.created, '%d-%b-%y %h:%i') AS createdDate, DATE_FORMAT(classes.modified, '%d-%b-%y %h:%i') AS modifiedDate, CONCAT(users1.first_name, ' ', users1.last_name ) AS createdBy, CONCAT(users2.first_name, ' ', users2.last_name ) AS modifiedBy

FROM classes LEFT JOIN classes AS classes_parent ON classes_parent.id = classes.parent_id LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON users1.id = classes.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS users2 ON users2.id = classes.modified_by
mapper.select: SELECT companies.id AS id, companies.`name` AS name FROM companies INNER JOIN class_companies ON class_companies.company_id = companies.id WHERE companies.is_active = 1 AND class_companies.class_id = #{classId}

SELECT users.id AS id, CONCAT(users.first_name, ' ', users.last_name) AS fullName FROM users INNER JOIN user_classes ON user_classes.user_id = users.id WHERE users.is_active = 1 AND user_classes.class_id = #{classId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO classes( parent_id, `name`, description, `ordering`, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{classAccount.parentId}, #{classAccount.name}, #{classAccount.description}, #{classAccount.ordering}, NOW(), #{classAccount.createdBy}, #{classAccount.isActive} );
mapper.update: UPDATE classes SET `parent_id` = #{classAccount.parentId}, `name` = #{classAccount.name}, `description` = #{classAccount.description}, `ordering` = #{classAccount.ordering}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{classAccount.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{classAccount.id}
